'''Battle droid squad 8313''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] carried aboard a [[Unidentified C-9979 landing craft|C-9979]] [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]]. The squad was deployed during the<ref name="SW:OW" /> [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sneaked onboard the landing craft after escaping the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]. On the order of his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Kenobi disabled the craft's communications gear to prevent the craft from alerting the other invasion vessels to his presence. When he destroyed the gear using his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], battle droid squad 8313 was sent to investigate the disruption and they unlocked the door to the room to enter.<ref name="SW:OW" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)}}
The squad confronted Kenobi, and the young Jedi cut down all the droids in the squad. Kenobi then continued through the door the squad had unlocked for him and ventured further inside the landing craft to disable its engines and force a landing.<ref name="SW:OW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Battle droid squad 8313 appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] during the ''Stowaway'' mission. It is possible to avoid destroying all units of the squad during this mission.
